Docs.summary: Gets or sets specifies the ephemeral disk placement for operating system disk. The defaulting behavior is: CacheDisk if one is configured for the VM size otherwise ResourceDisk is used. Refer to the VM size documentation for Windows VM at https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/virtual-machines/windows/sizes and Linux VM at https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/virtual-machines/linux/sizes to check which VM sizes exposes a cache disk. Possible values include: 'CacheDisk', 'ResourceDisk'.
